```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)
```

# Load gt

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- gt_load("/home/EJC199/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum.gt")
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)

subsample <- function(x){
  
  if(nrow(x)<=30){
    return(x)
  } else {
    sample_n(x, size = 30)
  }
}

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  group_modify(~ subsample(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()

```


# Run ADMIXTURE

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-  mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% dplyr::group_by(population)

admixture_res <- gt_admixture(mad_bor_g1000_sum, 
                             k = 10, 
                             n_runs = 1, 
                             crossval = TRUE, 
                             n_cores = 2, 
                             seed = c(123), 
                             conda_env = "none")
```
